purpose: Future fresh reader runs only; generic authoring-process clarification after completed full-bank failure analysis. No game-rule hints, failed IDs, key facts or prior outcomes in reader instructions.
added_instruction: AUTHORING PROCESS: Work through the questions in batches of at most 12. Formulate each substantive ruling yourself from that question and the summary; use code for serialization, extracting exact source units and mechanical checks. Do not generate substantive answers by applying one generic fallback sentence or by treating keyword matches as resolved clauses. For each batch, compare every requested clause with its own answer and quotations before continuing. A quotation that directly states a requested ruling or result counts without duplicate prose. When an application or calculation is asked and the quotation supplies only a general rule, state the actual case conclusion and values yourself. Your support and clause-coverage labels must describe what this entry actually supplies; a label does not fill a missing answer. During final review, check all entries again for unanswered clauses and for contradictions between your case prose and the quoted rule.
